test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3)** i.e. **‘write’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Darwin planned to ____ a book describing his….
 
• **‘write’ **is the most suitable in this context. Because a book is generally written by somebody else to describe something.
 
 
• **For example:** Rabindranath Tagore wrote many novels.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word** ‘write’ **contextually fits in the sentence.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is** Darwin planned to (1) ***write***__ a book describing his (2)_____ He spent nearly twenty years (3) _____the matter for his book, which was to deal with every known fact concerning the problem of the species. Unluckily for Darwin, a naturalist named Wallace had been (4) _____over the same problems and had reached the same solution. He sent Darwin an essay which almost word for word repeated Darwin's own ideas. Yet Wallace, who was an (5) ____, had been working far away in the Malay Archipelago, whilst Darwin had not left England for several years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Scribble : (रफ़ूचकार) **- Write or draw (something) quickly or carelessly, not suitable in this context.
 
• **Script : (लिपि)** - The written text of a play, film, or broadcast, not relevant here.
 
• **Paint : (रंग लगाना)** - Apply color to (a surface) with a brush, doesn’t fit the context.
